visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women in tight, strapless red floral dresses walk toward the camera through a bustling city street at night. Their expressions are confident and stoic. The background is filled with neon signs, digital billboards, and other pedestrians in winter attire. (2) The camera angle shifts as they continue their stride, passing a large digital billboard for '華梵禮儀'. They maintain a high-fashion walk, glancing occasionally at each other. (3) They pass a lit H&M storefront. The lighting is bright and colorful from various urban sources. Passers-by are visible in the background, some glancing at the pair. (4) The women stop walking and stand in a street food area. A man wearing a pink shirt and white scarf appears behind them, striking a series of comedic, confused, and exaggerated poses. The women continue to pose and look at each other, creating a humorous contrast.
